testcase.name: Scenario: ellipse-11 Retain an applied curvature setting when closing with Cancel: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/sketch/ellipse/scenario.feature:114:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: ellipse-11 Retain an applied curvature setting when closing with Cancel ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view ✔ And the user enables Display Curvature on the ellipse and records the slider positions ✔ Given the ellipse has a sparse curvature comb enabled ✔ And the upper and lower slider positions are recorded ✔ When the user open Setup Curvature Display ✔ And the user advance the upper slider ✔ And the user click Apply ✔ Then the dialog remains open with the denser comb visible ✔ When the user click Cancel ✔ Then the dialog closes and the denser comb remains ✔ When the user reopen Setup Curvature Display ✔ Then the upper slider remains at its applied position ✔ And the lower slider remains at its original position ✔ When the user move the upper slider back to its recorded original position ✔ And the user choose OK ✔ Then the dialog closes and the earlier sparse comb is displayed ✔ When the user reopen Setup Curvature Display ✔ Then both slider thumbs are at their original positions ✔ And OK and Apply are disabled ✔ When the user click Cancel without making changes ✔ Then the dialog closes and curvature display remains enabled ✔ When the user right-click the ellipse and select the checked Display Curvature option ✔ Then the comb disappears and the ellipse remains visible
